title: Block out your scene with simple gray boxes, type the desired motion in the…
content:
Block out your scene with simple gray boxes, type the desired motion in the prompt, place/drop cameras for the shots, then let Seedance 2.5 paint over the gray-box layout to generate the final video.

Use the open-source CozyClay tool via npx cozyclay to run this gray-box + camera + Seedance workflow.

Usa la herramienta de código abierto CozyClay mediante `npx cozyclay` para ejecutar este flujo de trabajo de caja gris + cámara + Seedance.
